{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Now filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of loyal customers who converted
conversion_rate = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Print the exact values used in evidence
print("Number of loyal customers:", len(loyal_df))
print("Number of converted loyal customers:", loyal_df['converted'].sum())
print("Conversion rate among loyal customers:", conversion_rate)"}
